risks.risk: The magnetron may be failed or the turntable motor may not work.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on, the turntable rotating, and successfully heating a cup of water.

risks.risk: The interior may be rusted, dirty, or missing the glass turntable plate.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior with the door open.

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage to the rear or sides not shown in the single front-facing photo.
risks.proof: Photos of the sides and the back of the unit.

proof_requests: Video of the microwave heating water and showing the turntable rotating.
Photo of the interior with the door open to confirm the presence of the glass plate.
Photos of the sides and rear of the unit to check for dents or cord damage.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the unit and its packaging. It can be priced at the worst-case scenario (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
